header: Questions we get about the invoice
lead: If yours is not here, write to abrechnung@example.org — we answer billing questions within one working day.
note: Answers current as at July 2026. Where an answer and your written offer disagree, the offer is the one that counts.

questions.title: Are your prices net or gross?
questions.bodytext: Net. Every figure on this site is exclusive of VAT, and 20 % Austrian VAT is added on the invoice. Practices with a valid UID number in another EU member state are invoiced without VAT under the reverse-charge rule.

questions.title: Who exactly counts as a practitioner?
questions.bodytext: Anyone who can be booked into the appointment book. Reception staff, practice managers, bookkeepers and owners who no longer treat all get accounts at no charge, because they do not occupy a slot. A student on placement who is booked under a supervisor's name does not count either.

questions.title: Do our patients pay anything?
questions.bodytext: No, and there is no arrangement under which they could. Patients do not have an account with us, do not enter payment details anywhere in Talbrunn and are never charged by us. Whatever they pay, they pay to your practice.

questions.title: How do we get the invoice?
questions.bodytext: By e-mail as a PDF, on the first working day of the following month, to whichever address you nominate. Every metered item appears as its own line with the count for the period beside it. Invoices for the last 24 months are downloadable from the practice settings.

questions.title: Can we pay yearly?
questions.bodytext: Yes, and it costs ten months instead of twelve. A yearly invoice is issued once, at the start of the term, and is not refunded pro rata if the practice leaves partway through — which is the trade-off for the two months.

questions.title: Does the price go up during our term?
questions.bodytext: Not within a term you have paid for, and not without three months' written notice at any time. We have raised the plan price once since 2021, by €6, and we wrote to every practice four months beforehand.

questions.title: What happens if an invoice is not paid?
questions.bodytext: We write, twice, three weeks apart. Nothing is switched off before the second reminder has been unanswered for a further fortnight, and even then the practice keeps read access and the export for another 30 days. A practice does not lose its diary because of a bounced direct debit.
